statBlock.name: Ancient Red Dragon
statBlock.description: An ancient red dragon watches its territory from mountain heights and prizes volcanic caverns for their heat and natural defenses.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dragon may use Frightful Presence before making one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. The dragon chooses creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of it. They must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of their turns to end the effect. A successful initial or repeat save or any other end to the effect grants immunity to this dragon’s Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 24 Dexterity save, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of the dragon’s turn. It cannot use these options while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Creatures within 15 ft. must pass a DC 25 Dexterity save or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. The dragon cannot repeat the previous round’s effect. It cannot use a lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Magma Geyser. Choose a spot on the ground the dragon can see within 120 ft. Magma erupts in a 20-ft.-high column with a 5-ft. radius. Creatures in it make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Tremor. Other creatures on the ground within 60 ft. of the dragon must make a DC 15 Dexterity save or fall Prone.
Volcanic Gas. Choose a point the dragon can see within 120 ft. Gas fills a 20-ft.-radius sphere, spreads around corners, and lightly obscures the area until initiative count 20 next round. A creature starting its turn there must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or become Poisoned until the end of that turn. It is also Incapacitated while Poisoned in this way.
sections.Regional effects: Choose one or more of these effects around a legendary dragon’s lair. Minor earthquakes are common within 6 miles. Water within 1 mile is unnaturally warm and sulfurous. Fissures within 1 mile form portals to the Elemental Plane of Fire, letting elemental creatures through. These effects fade over 1d10 days after the dragon dies.
sections.Variant spellcasting: If using the optional dragon rule, choose 6 spells of level 8 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 21, and its spell attack bonus is +13. The DM chooses the spells.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 86, 97 and 99. The official errata corrects the XP award to 62,000 and updates legendary and lair action timing.

statBlock.name: Young Red Dragon
statBlock.description: A young red dragon covets treasure and favors high ground where it can survey its territory.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Variant spellcasting: If using the optional dragon rule, choose 4 spells of level 3 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 16, and its spell attack bonus is +8. The DM chooses the spells.

statBlock.name: Young Red Shadow Dragon
statBlock.description: Exposure to the Shadowfell leaves this young red dragon charcoal-scaled, with translucent wings. It fights most effectively in dim light or darkness.

sections.Traits:
Living Shadow. In dim light or darkness, the dragon resists all damage except force, psychic and radiant.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, its attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks have disadvantage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, the dragon can take the Hide action.
sections.Shadow Dragon template: The printed sample has fire immunity and no lair actions. The broader template lets the DM retain, replace or drop lair actions when converting a true dragon. It also grants necrotic resistance, doubles its Stealth proficiency bonus, adds the three shadow traits, and converts elemental Bite damage and damaging breath weapons to necrotic. Only a true dragon born in the Shadowfell or exposed to it for several years qualifies. A dracolich cannot use this template.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Shadow Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 56 (16d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid this damage reduces to 0 HP dies. A Shadow rises from the corpse under the dragon’s control and acts immediately after it in initiative.
sections.Variant spellcasting: If using the optional dragon rule, choose 4 spells of level 4 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 16, and its spell attack bonus is +8. The DM chooses the spells. These numbers use the +4 proficiency implied by the printed attacks and saving throws.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 84–86. Page 85 provides this exact example.

statBlock.name: Adult Copper Dragon
statBlock.description: An adult copper dragon enjoys riddles and uses false walls and decoy treasures to guard its hoard.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dragon may use Frightful Presence before making one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. The dragon chooses creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of it. They must pass a DC 16 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of their turns to end the effect. A successful initial or repeat save or any other end to the effect grants immunity to this dragon’s Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose Acid Breath or Slowing Breath.
Acid Breath. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 18 Dexterity save. They take 54 (12d8) acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Slowing Breath. Creatures in a 60-ft. cone must pass a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature has half speed, cannot take reactions, and can make at most one attack on its turn. It may take an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The effects last 1 minute and end early on a successful repeat save at the end of any of the creature’s turns.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of the dragon’s turn. It cannot use these options while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Creatures within 10 ft. must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. The dragon cannot use a lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Stone Spikes. Choose a visible ground point within 120 ft. Spikes appear in a 20-ft. radius and work as Spike Growth. The area is difficult terrain. A creature moving into or within it takes 2d4 piercing damage per 5 ft. traveled. The spikes persist until the dragon uses this option again or dies.
Mud. Choose a visible 10-ft. square of ground within 120 ft. that turns into mud 3 ft. deep. Creatures on that ground when the mud appears must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or sink and become Restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 15 Strength check to free itself or a creature it can reach. Moving 1 ft. through the mud costs 2 ft. of movement. On initiative count 20 next round, the mud hardens and the Strength check DC becomes 20.
sections.Regional effects: Choose one or more of these effects around a legendary dragon’s lair. Stone terrain and objects within 6 miles can display magical carvings of the dragon smiling. Within 1 mile, Tiny beasts that cannot normally speak can magically speak and understand Draconic. They praise the dragon and cannot reveal its whereabouts. Intelligent creatures within 1 mile are prone to giggling even at serious things. When the dragon dies, carvings fade over 1d10 days and the other effects end immediately.
sections.Variant spellcasting: If using the optional dragon rule, choose 3 spells of level 4 or lower. The dragon can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 16, and its spell attack bonus is +8. The DM chooses the spells.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 86 and 111–112. Legendary and lair action timing follows the official errata.
